key.name: laccy-toggle-shortcut
key.description: Opens the clipboard history popup, or closes it when it is open.

key.name: paste-automatically
key.description: Also paste into the focused app after picking an item, instead of only copying it. Alt+Enter does the opposite.

key.name: history-size
key.description: Number of unpinned items kept in history. Pinned items are always kept.

key.name: ignored-apps
key.description: Desktop app IDs whose copies are never recorded, e.g. org.keepassxc.KeePassXC.desktop.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Shows a Laccy icon in the top bar. Click it to open the clipboard history; right-click it for more options.

key.name: max-item-bytes
key.description: Copies larger than this many bytes are not recorded.
